title: My  Poetry
author: Sreedharan Parokode
text:
POEMs come to me
with some consolation words
when I felt miserably sad,
thinking of the dont`s done
to the deprived calculations!

They say to me `to rise to
the occasion`
avoiding
silence and shyness when
atrocities peep!

Children, are they, trying to
play with me in my mirth
with positive attitudes!

Poems are my friends,
on some moments,
taking
to the height of nourishing thoughtfulness of
golden moments to accept
victorious vicinity!

AND

They caution me against
alluring agenda, leading
to permanent despair and
perpetual degradation...

They constantly exhort me
to remain happy with what I have!!
stanzas: They say to me `to rise to
play with me in my mirth
to the height of nourishing thoughtfulness of
to remain happy with what I have!!
